overview_description.description:
LAB is a social crypto trading app built for both casual investors and active traders. It lets users hold, swap, and send Ethereum, Solana, USDT, BNB, and 100+ other tokens, alongside tokenized stocks and Robinhood Chain assets, all from one mobile app. 
LAB combines social features - follow other traders, compare performance on leaderboards, and chat inside the app - with practical trading tools like real-time portfolio tracking, and flexible staking with reward boosts for active users. 
Whether someone's buying their first token or actively trading tokenized stocks and crypto, LAB is designed to make investing social, simple, and rewarding.
